verdict.rationale: Okta's docs describe building an Okta integration that uses SCIM to handle user provisioning, with a defined schema and CRUD API for users and groups, so the core push-provisioning capability is documented. The evidence does not show entitlement provisioning or that pushes fire the moment access is assigned. Missing for 10: entitlement provisioning, assignment-triggered real-time push behavior, group push depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, accounts create themselves — SCIM provisioning pushes users, groups, and entitlements into downstream apps the moment access is assigned

citations.quote: This guide series teaches you how to build an Okta integration that uses the System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) protocol to handle user provisioning.
SCIM provides a defined schema for representing users and groups, and a RESTful API to run CRUD operations on those user and group resources.
